hero.title: About Me
hero.description: Hello everyone! My name is Văn Trung Thành, and I am an Information Technology student at Ho Chi Minh City Open University, focusing on Software Engineering. I am also interested in training and developing AI models. Although I sometimes feel burned out from work, I always stay determined and do my best to complete my tasks well.

cv.overview_page_1: Page 1 summarizes my career plans and milestones, academic achievements at Ho Chi Minh City Open University, a certificate in AI research, and foundational courses.
cv.overview_page_2: Page 2 presents three work experiences and projects, skills I have learned and practiced, personal interests, and activities I enjoy in my free time.

header.title: Featured Technical Projects
header.subtitle: AI Agent systems, distributed backend architecture, natural language processing models, and real-time platforms.

aijmc.title: AI IT Job Market Consultant (AIJMC)
aijmc.summary: An AI-powered platform for analyzing the IT job market and providing career advice using ReAct AI Agents and multi-layer RAG.
aijmc.description: The system collects and analyzes job data from ITViec, TopDev, and VietnamWorks using Celery and Crawlee. It uses Hybrid Retrieval with pgvector, combining semantic search and large language models to provide personalized career guidance.

aijmc_jpra.title: AIJMC-JPRA: Job Posting Reliability Analysis
aijmc_jpra.summary: A scientific research project following the IEEE conference format to detect fake job postings and verify their authenticity.
aijmc_jpra.description: A binary classification model evaluates the reliability of job postings through their URLs. It uses PydanticAI Agents and real-time web retrieval with Playwright to check evidence, calculate reliability scores, and provide detailed explanations.

mbms.title: Medical Booking Management System (MBMS)
mbms.summary: An online medical appointment booking and management platform for clinics, developed as a PWA and native app.
mbms.description: A digital solution for managing medical appointments at healthcare facilities. It improves the experience of patients and doctors through AI-Driven Development (AIDD) and Scrum, with complete deployment using Docker.

ai_writing_indicator.title: AI-Generated Text Detection Indicator
ai_writing_indicator.summary: A binary machine learning model designed to detect AI-generated Vietnamese text in journalism.
ai_writing_indicator.description: Research and training of a specialized Vietnamese NLP pipeline to distinguish human-written news articles from content generated by large language models (LLMs), supporting originality checks in digital publishing.

elearning_lcms.title: Learning Content Management System (LCMS)
elearning_lcms.summary: A complete LCMS platform for managing, storing, and reusing digital learning resources, built with Django REST Framework.
elearning_lcms.description: A backend architecture for managing digital learning content using MySQL, OAuth2 token-based access control, an admin statistics dashboard, and Google GenAI integration for personalized learning material recommendations.

sports_field_booking.title: Sports Field Booking & Automated Testing
sports_field_booking.summary: A time-slot booking system for football, badminton, and tennis courts with a complete automated testing process.
sports_field_booking.description: A web application built with Flask and MySQL for searching and booking sports facilities in real time. It follows a strict quality testing process, covering Unit, Integration, System, and Acceptance Testing with Selenium 3.
